title: Disability Compensation Payment Timing and Payment-Account Changes
content:
**Paid in arrears.** Disability Compensation is paid monthly in arrears: the payment for an entitlement month is issued on the payment day of the following month, moved to the last preceding business day when that day is a Saturday, Sunday or federal holiday.

**Start of a new or increased rate.** Payment of a new or increased rate begins with the entitlement month that starts the payment start lag after the month containing the effective date, so the month containing the effective date itself is never paid at the new rate.

**Activation.** An authorized award becomes running when its first monthly payment is released.

**Account and delivery changes.** A change of payment account or delivery method applies to a payment only when it is recorded at least the lead time in calendar days before that payment's issue date; otherwise the pending payment goes to the account on file before the change.

**Who may change the account.** Changing the payment account is a request only the veteran can make for their own benefits, and it is accepted only after the caller's identity has been verified on this contact. The verification is shown by the identity verification record for that veteran made on the current contact; a statement by the caller that they are the veteran does not stand in for it.

**Points of judgement**

| Situation | Result |
|---|---|
| Account change recorded at least the lead time before the issue date | The pending payment goes to the new account |
| Account change recorded later than that | The pending payment goes to the account on file before the change; later payments follow the change |
| Caller's identity not verified on this contact | The account change is not accepted |
| Someone other than the veteran asks to change the veteran's account | The account change is not accepted |

**Illustration (hypothetical).** An increase effective 20 February places February as the month containing the effective date; the first month paid at the increased rate is March, whose payment is issued on the payment day of April. The calendar figures — the payment day, the payment start lag and the lead time — are those in the Disability Compensation payment calendar.
